name: appshot
description: Press a shortcut in any Mac app to put a screenshot and the text of the window in front into your Claude prompt

shortcut.title: Shortcut
shortcut.description: Both keys of one modifier held together (option+option, command+command, control+control, shift+shift) or a chord such as ctrl+shift+s

focusClaude.title: Bring Claude to the front
focusClaude.description: Switch to Claude after a capture so you can type your question

sound.title: Shutter sound
sound.description: Play the macOS screenshot sound on each capture
